calls.title: Lonely Planet<>GrowthBook - Demo & Discussion
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Jake Heier (account executive) and Logan Bates (technical counterpart) demoed their experimentation platform to Lonely Planet's team, including Ruiye Ni (data & AI lead), Marcos Kashima (product management), Gabriel Smith (design lead), and others.
